posts.summary_en: The guide board's rune table per cookie after 1.5.002, in priority order per cookie. For Guild Conquest the author ranks skill amp first and skill haste second; Chardonnay gets skill amp because it raises her crit-rate buff, though the amp doesn't apply to her own skill.

advice.text: Dealers: skill amp, crit damage, ATK (Brightseeker adds skill haste first). Milk: ATK. Chardonnay: skill amp.
Reroll unlocked: the first option is the priority, the later ones are kept when they roll, because currency is short.

damage.text: Current Conquest meta: skill amp first, then skill haste; Brightseeker needs 40+ haste.
(comment) Chardonnay's skill amp raises her crit-rate buff, which beats raising crit rate directly.

quotes.kr: 다만 현재 토벌 메타에는 스증 1순위, 다음이 스가 챙기는게 제일 좋습니다
quotes.en: (author's reply) In the current Conquest meta skill amp is first, then skill haste.
(author's reply) Raising the crit-rate buff through skill amp is better.

posts.summary_en: A creator's Conquest guide with the Chardonnay deck. In the comments the author gives the Conquest gear sub-stats by slot group, and says the set is for Conquest only: stages want accuracy and focus, and crit resistance there only pads power. A reader reports clearing 4T easily since the level expansion and the new cookie, up from 1.8T.

datapoints.cost: level expansion and the new cookie
datapoints.note: a comment; cause split between the level cap and Chardonnay; no power figure

advice.text: Conquest gear: the three weapons skill amp + crit rate (some say ATK is better); the three armour pieces damage reduction + HP; the upper accessories skill haste + skill amp; the lower accessories damage reduction + skill haste.

damage.text: Weapons skill amp + crit rate; armour damage reduction + HP (crit resistance raises power but is a dead line); upper accessories haste + amp; lower accessories DR + haste (amp can't roll there).
Stage gear takes accuracy and focus first; crit resistance pads displayed power only.

quotes.kr: 무기 3개 증폭 + 치확 (공격력이 더 좋다는 말도 있는데 일단 치확 씀)
quotes.en: (author) Weapons: skill amp + crit rate (some say ATK is better; I use crit rate for now).

quotes.kr: 레벨 확장에 신쿠 나온뒤로 4T는 그냥 쉽게 넘기던데 원래 1.8T였는데
quotes.en: (comment) Since the level expansion and the new cookie I pass 4T easily; I was at 1.8T.

posts.summary_en: The same creator's 3.1T Conquest guide (Strawberry Crepe variant). A reader with an 8★ Brightseeker, all-haste runes and mostly skill-amp runes averages 1.2–1.3T and asks whether the gap is spec or retries.
A shatter rant; a commenter asks for a plating pity ceiling.
